work.title: The Magic School Bus Rides Again
work.note: The Magic School Bus Rides Again é uma nova versão da série animada, lançada em 2017 pela Netflix em parceria com a Scholastic. A cena cultural serve de ponte para o foco “falar do ônibus: catch the bus (pegar o ônibus a tempo) e miss the bus (perder o ônibus)”. A referência mostra um ônibus escolar: catch the bus, miss the bus.

pages.title: A new charger · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Saturday morning in Denver. Leo has a small problem with his phone. The battery is low, and his charger does not work. He walks into a store on Main Street. A clerk named Mia stands behind the counter. She smiles and waits for him.
“Hi! Can I help you?” says Mia. “Yes. My charger does not work.” says Leo. “Let me see it. Is it a phone charger?” says Mia.
